description:
Get a brand profile (name, country, founded, description) and its top fragrances. Use the brand slug, e.g. 'maison-francis-kurkdjian'.

See also: `fragrance_search` with the `brand` filter to get the full paginated catalogue for this brand · `perfumer_get` if the brand has a known house perfumer.
